---
name: Setup did not work
about: The path from clone to first episode failed
labels: setup
---

Getting from a fresh clone to one real episode is the thing this repo is
supposed to do well, so a report that it didn't is genuinely useful.

**How far you got** — which step in [docs/SETUP.md](../../blob/main/docs/SETUP.md)
or [AGENTS.md](../../blob/main/AGENTS.md), and what stopped you.

**What the tool told you.** `npm run demo` tries to name exactly what is
missing; if its message was wrong, unhelpful, or absent, say so — that is a bug
in its own right.

**Were you following it yourself, or did you hand AGENTS.md to a coding agent?**
If an agent, which one, and where did it go wrong. It is meant to work either
way.

**Your setup** — OS, Node version, and whether `ffmpeg` and ImageMagick are on
your PATH.

**Please redact** keys, tokens, bucket URLs and any child's name before posting.
